settings.text: Take a quick online health quiz — just a few minutes. A licensed provider reviews your info to confirm if MorePumps is appropriate. If approved, your prescription is sent to the pharmacy and shipped straight to your door in discreet packaging. No waiting rooms. Just private, convenient care from home.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Like any prescription, ED treatments may
settings.text: Like any prescription, ED treatments may cause side effects such as headache, flushing, or nasal congestion. Serious side effects are rare but possible. That’s why a licensed provider reviews your health info before approval. If you have concerns, you can always reach out for support.

settings.text: Prescription treatments can’t be refunded or returned once shipped. However, you can cancel your subscription anytime directly through your patient portal. If you believe there’s an issue with your subscription, reach out to our support team for help.
